description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller with basic endpoints for health checks, documentation redirect, and application info for the notes backend project.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as greeting, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info for the notes backend.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check status of the application.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns a basic string with application information.
